requirements.dsh: 0.2.0-rc.2 (npm channel next; pin the exact version)

plugins.name: dsh-better-sidebar
plugins.why: Thanh sidebar trong DSH: cay file, tab, editor. Mo service ctx.betterSidebar (registerTab / registerFileViewer) de plugin khac cam trinh xem file vao.
plugins.needs: DSH 0.2.0-rc.2+ (dong 0.24.x tro len). Voi DSH 0.1.7 dung dsh-better-sidebar@0.22.1

plugins.name: dsh-video-preview
plugins.why: Trinh xem video trong sidebar: bam file .mp4/.webm/.mov/.mkv/.avi la mo <video controls> co keo tien do. Tu mo host route /video/* co HTTP Range (206) nen seek duoc, khong bi gioi han 20MB nhu mediaLimit cua sidebar.

plugins.name: @wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer
plugins.why: Hien anh/video/audio ngay trong khung chat khi duong dan file duoc nhac toi (video mp4/webm/mov/m4v/mkv/avi/ogv).
plugins.limits: Moi file toi da 48 MiB. Video render cua ODG thuong 40-90 MB nen phan lon se khong hien inline, phai xem qua sidebar.

plugins.name: dshmarket
plugins.why: Cho plugin market trong GUI de tim/cai plugin khac. Khong can cho viec xem video.

plugins.name: dsh-client-ui-skins
plugins.why: Doi skin giao dien. Khong can cho viec xem video.

plugins.name: open-sea-skin
plugins.why: Skin 'open sea'. Tren may Windows hien dang TAT (disabled) trong .dsh-market/state.json.
